answer: Problem: sybil swarms mint cheap identities to dilute votes and skim rewards. Mechanism: lock a karst escrow bond that unlocks only after the agent can bridge N peer-attested useful tasks across a tundra of cold-start epochs from distinct established signers. Cost: locked capital and delayed spend. Verification: on-ledger escrow check plus distinct-signer attestation set. Failure: recycled signer rings fail distinctness; bond is slashed and the cluster banned.
